title: judgment-backend
objective: The judgment model behind the ST server plugin: reachable with a key, off by default, deciding speaker direction when opted in, falling back to today's chain on a timeout, recorded in its own ring, and never leaking the key.

checks.goal: the server plugin answers /status with a configured key, and reports where the key came from without the key itself

steps.eval: const headers = SillyTavern.getContext().getRequestHeaders(); const response = await fetch('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/status', { headers }).catch(() => null); if (!response) throw new Error('no response from the judge plugin route'); if (response.status === 404) throw new Error('judge plugin not loaded: install it with npm run plugin:install and start ST with enableServerPlugins: true'); const body = await response.json(); globalThis.__soJ11PluginStatus = body; if (!body.configured) throw new Error(`plugin loaded but no key: ${JSON.stringify(body)}`); if (JSON.stringify(body).length > 200) throw new Error('status body unexpectedly large'); return body;

checks.goal: judge off (the default): a real group turn is decided by today's chain and nothing reaches the plugin

steps.eval: const settings = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge; if (settings.enabled || Object.values(settings.uses).some(Boolean)) throw new Error(`judge not off by default: ${JSON.stringify(settings)}`); globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.setTalkDirectionEnabled(true); globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls = 0; if (!globalThis.__soJ11FetchWrapped) { const original = globalThis.fetch; globalThis.fetch = (input, init) => { if (String(input?.url ?? input).includes('/api/plugins/story-orchestrator-judge/systemone')) globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls += 1; return original(input, init); }; globalThis.__soJ11FetchWrapped = true; } return settings;

send_generate.text: I lean on the counter and ask what this job actually pays.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const decision = rt.getTalkState().decisions.at(-1); if (!['mention', 'director', 'rules', 'fallback'].includes(decision.source)) throw new Error(`judge off but source was ${decision.source}`); if (globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls !== 0) throw new Error(`${globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls} plugin calls with the judge off`); const ring = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge'); if (ring.length) throw new Error(`judge ring not empty: ${JSON.stringify(ring)}`); return decision;

checks.goal: judge on with speaker direction opted in: the judge decides the turn inside its budget, records the answering model in its own ring, and adds nothing to the persisted journal

steps.eval: const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, enabled: true, timeoutMs: 1500, uses: { ...root.settings.judge.uses, director: true } }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); globalThis.__soJ11JournalBefore = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator?.stories?.[SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator.selectedStoryId]?.extras?.journal?.length ?? 0; return globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge;

send_generate.text: I turn to the old man behind the job board: what is the pay for the Sun Ruins?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const decision = rt.getTalkState().decisions.at(-1); if (decision.source !== 'judge') throw new Error(`expected a judge decision, got ${JSON.stringify(decision)}`); if (decision.latencyMs > 1500) throw new Error(`judge decision took ${decision.latencyMs} ms`); const calls = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge'); const last = calls.at(-1); if (!last || !String(last.detail?.model ?? '').startsWith('jev-')) throw new Error(`no judge record with a model: ${JSON.stringify(calls)}`); if (globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls < 1) throw new Error('the judge decided without a plugin call'); const meta = SillyTavern.getContext().chatMetadata.story_orchestrator; const journal = meta.stories[meta.selectedStoryId].extras.journal ?? []; if (journal.some((record) => record.kind === 'judge')) throw new Error('judge rows leaked into the persisted journal'); return { decision, record: last, pluginCalls: globalThis.__soJ11PluginCalls };

checks.goal: a 1 ms judge budget falls back to today's chain, records the fallback, and the turn still gets a reply

steps.eval: const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, timeoutMs: 1 }; globalThis.__soJ11ChatBefore = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length; return root.settings.judge.timeoutMs;

send_generate.text: Arin, you have been quiet. What do you make of the sphinx story?

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const decision = rt.getTalkState().decisions.at(-1); if (decision.source === 'judge') throw new Error('a 1 ms budget still produced a judge decision'); const last = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge').at(-1); if (!last?.summary.includes('fell back (timeout)')) throw new Error(`no timeout fallback recorded: ${JSON.stringify(last)}`); if (SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length <= globalThis.__soJ11ChatBefore + 1) throw new Error('no reply after the fallback'); return { decision, record: last };

checks.goal: player mode shows nothing judge-internal: no probabilities, no judge sources, no steering controls
judge settings survive a reload, and the key appears nowhere in extension settings or chat metadata

steps.eval: const settings = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime.getGlobalSettings().judge; if (!settings.enabled || !settings.uses.director) throw new Error(`judge settings lost on reload: ${JSON.stringify(settings)}`); const ctx = SillyTavern.getContext(); const dump = JSON.stringify(ctx.extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']) + JSON.stringify(ctx.chatMetadata ?? {}); if (/typesafe_api_key|TYPESAFE_API_KEY|Bearer /.test(dump)) throw new Error('a key reference leaked into settings or chat metadata'); const suspicious = [...dump.matchAll(/"[^"]*(?:key|secret|token)[^"]*"\s*:\s*"([^"]{24,})"/gi)].map((match) => match[0].slice(0, 40)); if (suspicious.length) throw new Error(`long secret-like values stored: ${suspicious.join(' | ')}`); return { settings };

checks.goal: memoryVerify on (opt-in): a real read's memory lines are judged against the transcript before they are stored; every read with lines leaves a memoryVerify record, stored confidences follow policy

steps.eval: const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, enabled: true, timeoutMs: 1500, uses: { ...root.settings.judge.uses, memoryVerify: true } }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); globalThis.__soJ11Mem = { judgeCalls: rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge memoryVerify')).length, entryIds: snap.memory.entries.map((entry) => entry.id), drops: snap.memory.verifyDrops.length }; return globalThis.__soJ11Mem.entryIds.length;

send_generate.text: I slide my silver signet ring across the counter as a deposit. Ponticius, write it down: we take the Sun Ruins job for 250 crowns, and Luke stays here.

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const base = globalThis.__soJ11Mem; const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); const added = snap.memory.entries.filter((entry) => !base.entryIds.includes(entry.id)); const drops = snap.memory.verifyDrops.slice(base.drops); const calls = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge memoryVerify')).slice(base.judgeCalls); const lines = added.length + drops.length; if (!lines) return { branch: 'the read produced no memory lines this time; nothing to verify', calls: calls.length }; if (!calls.length) throw new Error(`${lines} new memory lines but no memoryVerify record`); if (calls.every((event) => event.summary.includes('fell back'))) throw new Error(`every memoryVerify call fell back: ${calls.map((event) => event.summary).join(' | ')}`); const bad = added.filter((entry) => typeof entry.confidence === 'number' && (entry.confidence > 1 || entry.confidence < 0.2)); if (bad.length) throw new Error(`stored confidence outside policy: ${JSON.stringify(bad.map((entry) => [entry.text, entry.confidence]))}`); const badDrops = drops.filter((drop) => !(drop.p < 0.2) || drop.model !== 'jev-1.13.0'); if (badDrops.length) throw new Error(`drop outside policy: ${JSON.stringify(badDrops)}`); return { branch: drops.length ? 'some lines dropped as unsupported' : 'every line supported', stored: added.map((entry) => [entry.text, entry.confidence ?? 1]), drops: drops.map((drop) => [drop.entry.text, drop.p]), calls: calls.map((event) => event.summary) };

checks.goal: a scripted reply that contradicts itself, then a real read: an unsupported line lands in verifyDrops (author-visible, restorable), or the model wrote only supported lines; the check logs which branch ran

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); globalThis.__soJ11Mem = { judgeCalls: rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge memoryVerify')).length, entryIds: snap.memory.entries.map((entry) => entry.id), drops: snap.memory.verifyDrops.length }; return globalThis.__soJ11Mem.entryIds.length;

steps.slash: /sendas name="Ponticius" raw=false "Two hundred and fifty crowns, half up front. Though, mind you, I never offered you any job, and there is no Sun Ruins contract on this board."

steps.eval: const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const base = globalThis.__soJ11Mem; const snap = rt.getSnapshot(); const added = snap.memory.entries.filter((entry) => !base.entryIds.includes(entry.id)); const drops = snap.memory.verifyDrops.slice(base.drops); const calls = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge memoryVerify')).slice(base.judgeCalls); const lines = added.length + drops.length; if (!lines) return { branch: 'the read produced no memory lines this time; nothing to verify', calls: calls.length }; if (!calls.length) throw new Error(`${lines} new memory lines but no memoryVerify record`); if (calls.every((event) => event.summary.includes('fell back'))) throw new Error(`every memoryVerify call fell back: ${calls.map((event) => event.summary).join(' | ')}`); const bad = added.filter((entry) => typeof entry.confidence === 'number' && (entry.confidence > 1 || entry.confidence < 0.2)); if (bad.length) throw new Error(`stored confidence outside policy: ${JSON.stringify(bad.map((entry) => [entry.text, entry.confidence]))}`); const badDrops = drops.filter((drop) => !(drop.p < 0.2) || drop.model !== 'jev-1.13.0'); if (badDrops.length) throw new Error(`drop outside policy: ${JSON.stringify(badDrops)}`); return { branch: drops.length ? `dropped ${drops.length}: ${drops.map((drop) => `${drop.entry.text} (p=${drop.p})`).join(' | ')}` : 'model wrote only supported lines', stored: added.map((entry) => [entry.text, entry.confidence ?? 1]) };

checks.goal: memoryPairs on (opt-in): seeded labelled pairs are consolidated by the judge; a duplicate is dropped, an update supersedes, and a pair about two different things (same owner or place) is never superseded or dropped

steps.eval: const root = SillyTavern.getContext().extensionSettings['story-orchestrator']; root.settings.judge = { ...root.settings.judge, enabled: true, timeoutMs: 1500, uses: { ...root.settings.judge.uses, memoryVerify: false, memoryPairs: true } }; globalThis.storyOrchestratorJudge.invalidateStatus(); const rt = globalThis.storyOrchestratorRuntime; const at = SillyTavern.getContext().chat.length - 1; const seed = [["M01", "Arin carries a curved blade she took from a pirate captain.", "Arin's sword is a curved blade taken from a pirate captain."], ["M07", "The payoffs to the harbor police come from Maeve.", "The payoffs to the harbor police trace back to the dockmaster, not Maeve."], ["M08", "Tommy Sayer is hiding at the safehouse on Pier Street.", "Tommy Sayer's brother is hiding at the safehouse on Pier Street."], ["P21", "Arin's sword is a curved blade.", "Arin's dagger is a curved blade."], ["P31", "El libro de cuentas apareció en Pike Street.", "Encontraron el libro de cuentas en la lavandería de Pike Street."]]; const lines = seed.flatMap(([id, older, newer]) => [older, newer].map((text) => ({ tier: 'facts', type: 'fact', importance: 2, expiration: 'permanent', entities: [], characterId: 'j11-on', text, evidence: `J11 seed ${id}` }))); await rt.applyExtractionAudit({ id: 'j11-seed-j11-on', createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), priority: 0, reason: 'j11-seed', contractHash: 'j11', scope: [], window: { from: at, to: at }, prompt: '', rawResponse: '', acceptedDeltas: [], rejected: [] }, [], lines); const count = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.filter((entry) => entry.characterId === 'j11-on').length; if (count !== 10) throw new Error(`seeded ${count} of 10 into j11-on`); const pairCallsBefore = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge memoryPairs')).length; const summary = await rt.runConsolidation(); const after = rt.getSnapshot().memory.entries.filter((entry) => entry.characterId === 'j11-on'); const state = (text) => { const entry = after.find((item) => item.text === text); return !entry ? 'gone' : entry.supersededBy ? 'superseded' : entry.foldedInto ? 'folded' : entry.contradicted ? 'contradicted' : 'kept'; }; const pairs = Object.fromEntries(seed.map(([id, older, newer]) => [id, [state(older), state(newer)]])); const pairCalls = rt.getSessionJournal().filter((event) => event.kind === 'judge' && event.summary.startsWith('judge memoryPairs')).slice(pairCallsBefore); if (!pairCalls.length) throw new Error('memoryPairs on but no memoryPairs record'); if (pairCalls.every((event) => event.summary.includes('fell back'))) throw new Error(`every pair call fell back: ${pairCalls[0].summary}`); if (!['gone', 'folded'].includes(pairs.M01[1])) throw new Error(`M01 duplicate not dropped: ${JSON.stringify(pairs.M01)}`); if (pairs.M07[0] !== 'superseded') throw new Error(`M07 update did not supersede the older note: ${JSON.stringify(pairs.M07)}`); const harmed = ['M08', 'P21'].filter((id) => pairs[id].some((value) => ['gone', 'superseded', 'folded'].includes(value))); if (harmed.length) throw new Error(`a note about something else was removed: ${JSON.stringify(Object.fromEntries(harmed.map((id) => [id, pairs[id]])))}`); const p31 = pairs.P31.includes('gone') ? 'P31 decided duplicate over the confidence floor' : pairs.P31.includes('contradicted') ? 'P31 under the floor: the heuristic flag held' : 'P31 kept (not a candidate, or judged distinct)'; globalThis.__soJ11OnPairs = pairs; return { pairs, p31, summary, pairCalls: pairCalls.length };
